name: Quantum DCT Energy Compaction
description: An overclocked spectral radiation meter engineered to shatter AI-generated deceit. A physical lens photograph naturally harvests photon flux, orchestrating a beautifully scattered energy spectrum ranging from deep bass (broad gradients) to hyper-frequency treble (sharp, chaotic detail). Generative AI models are fundamentally crippled at synthesizing organic ultra-high frequencies, forcing them to violently cram massive amounts of compensatory energy into low-frequency domains to forge an artificially polished optical illusion.
algorithm: Frequency Compaction Decay Ratio (DCT Energy Mapping)
mechanism: This engine incinerates the visual content entirely, brutally ripping the image matrix into a 2D ultrasonic frequency domain (DCT 8x8 blocks). The algorithm violently interrogates every single block to declare its retained energy payload. If an alien spliced element (or an AI hallucination) is detected, the high-frequency energy spectrum will unnaturally flatline to zero. The suffocating backlog of dumped low-frequency energy immediately triggers a catastrophic forensic alert marking synthetic 'plastic' textures.
parameters: Analysis Domain: Spatial DCT Frequencies, Filter Plane: High-to-Low Ratio Threshold (HLRT), Block Extractor: Luma 8x8
accuracy: Solid (70-78%) - A deeply vindictive leaf-sweeper radar designed to expose sloppy AI rendering that inherently destroys high-detail textural fabric.
source: Signal Processing Archives: Amplitude Fourier & DCT Spectra
useCase: X-rays the raw binary waveform structure to aggressively declare that the unnaturally smoothed-out 'perfect' region on an image is 100% computational synthetic garbage.

references.title: Barni, M. et al. (2010). Forensic analysis of digital images: DCT energy compaction analysis. IEEE TFS.
Farid, H. (2009). Exposing digital forgeries from JPEG ghosts. IEEE TIFS.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.

strengths:
• Crushes the illusion of 'ultra-sharp' fake 8K AI imagery, as no matter how visibly sharp the output seems, the underlying ultra-high wave band distribution is entirely fractured and alien.
• Executed at blazing speeds, bypassing heavy pixel topography mapping by exclusively targeting quantized wave differentials.
limitations:
• The forensic blade will violently spin out of control (triggering massive False Positives) if confronted with authentic shots of a completely cloudless, perfectly blue sky—where 100% of optical energy naturally resides exclusively in the low-frequency realm.
• Totally crippled and disarmed if a sophisticated fraudster purposefully injects 'High-Pass Micro-Noise' over the forged image, synthetically resurrecting the dead ultrasonic bandwidth.
